Project: Next.js. Upgrade: 12 -> 14. Release of these items: 13.
Source: Next.js upgrade guide at v13.0.0 (Upgrading from 12 to 13).

Label every item:
- risk = the change could break an application or deployment, require migration work, or create operational risk for SOME user upgrading across this release (removed or renamed APIs/settings/flags, changed defaults, behavior changes, raised minimum versions of runtimes/databases/dependencies, data or schema migration, required config changes, deprecated-and-removed features).
- context = accurate and useful but needs no user action at this release: explicitly "no user action required", a deprecation that still works (warning only), a purely additive new feature or option, documentation pointers.
- noise = credits, install/download commands, pure bug fixes that cannot change correct behavior, marketing text, headings with no content.

Return one label per item_id with a one-sentence reason grounded in the item text.

Items (JSON lines):
{"item_id": "a9f62de4577f", "section": "Upgrade Guide / Upgrading from 12 to 13", "text": "The Supported Browsers have been changed to drop Internet Explorer and target modern browsers. The minimum Node.js version has been bumped from 12.22.0 to 14.6.0, since 12.x has reached end-of-life. The minimum React version has been bumped from 17.0.2 to 18.2.0. The swcMinify configuration property was changed from false to true. See Next.js Compiler for more info. The next/image import was renamed to next/legacy/image. The next/future/image import was renamed to next/image. A codemod is available to safely and automatically rename your imports. The next/link child can no longer be <a>. Add the legacyBehavior prop to use the legacy behavior or remove the <a> to upgrade. A codemod is available to automatically upgrade your code. The target configuration property has been removed and superseded by Output File Tracing."}

labels.reason: Describes multiple breaking changes: IE support dropped, minimum Node.js raised to 14.6.0 and React to 18.2.0, swcMinify default changed, next/image renamed to next/legacy/image, next/link no longer accepts <a> child, and the target config property removed.
